fileTitle: Sabio x DICK'S Sporting Goods: Holiday Across Two Banners
footer: Proactive point of view for Zenith

slides.title: One holiday, two banners, one household
slides.subtitle: DICK'S is growing and Foot Locker is resetting. App Science® finds the sneaker, outdoor and youth sports homes that can shop both banners, and reaches them on the TV they watch.
slides.meta: Proactive recommendation | Prepared for Zenith | October 2026 | US only
slides.names:
Will Phung · Amanda Grond · Stamos Biliris
Ben Bring · Isabella Imbriano

stat.label: Q2 comps, side by side
stat.body: DICK'S banner comps grew 4.9% in Q2. Foot Locker fell 3.6%, and its full-year comp guide moved to -2%. Holiday is the first big test of the combined business. [1]

slides.title: What's happening at DICK'S right now
slides.kicker: Four signals from the last six months · Numbered sources on page 10

items.head: Net sales up 53% to $5.59B with Foot Locker in
items.body: The DICK'S banner grew comps 4.9%, helped by World Cup demand, a bigger ticket and more transactions. [1]
items.means: The core banner has momentum to carry into holiday.

items.head: Foot Locker comps fell 3.6%
items.body: Legacy footwear was soft. 110 stores closed in the first half, leaving 2,478. The full-year Foot Locker comp guide is now -2%. [1]
items.means: Foot Locker shoppers are the swing group for the combined business.

items.head: 36 House of Sport stores and a Foot Locker remodel
items.body: DICK'S runs 36 House of Sport and 44 Field House stores. The Fast Break remodel was set to reach about 250 Foot Locker stores by back-to-school. [2]
items.means: New store formats need nearby households who know they exist.

items.head: Holiday sales forecast to grow 4.0% to 4.8%
items.body: Deloitte expects $1.70T to $1.71T in holiday sales. It sees e-commerce growing 7.5% to 8.4%. [3]
items.means: A modest season rewards share-taking, not waiting for the market.

slides.title: The opening: sell both banners to one home
slides.kicker: Why the holiday plan should target households, not banners
slides.statLabel: Share of US TV time spent on streaming in July 2026. Broadcast was 19.5%.
slides.headline: We think DICK'S wins holiday by reaching the homes that shop sneakers, gear and team sports, wherever they buy today.

points.head: Two banners, one household
points.body: A Foot Locker app home is now a DICK'S customer too. We can see both apps on the phones in that home and plan one message across them.

points.head: Apps show who is shopping now
points.body: Sneaker, outdoor and youth sports apps opened in the last 30 days tell us who is buying this season, not who fit a profile last year.

points.head: The TV is where gifting is decided
points.body: Half of TV time is streaming. We put the plan there, then follow the same homes to the phone and the store.

slides.title: Sabio at a glance
slides.kicker: Our own data, ad tech and content since 2014 · A Publicis partner for 9+ years
slides.takeaway: the sneaker, outdoor and youth sports homes, found by the apps they use and reached on 115MM CTV households, from a partner that owns the data, the supply and the creators.

slides.title: Three audiences for the holiday window
slides.kicker: Each one is an app ecosystem, not a demographic · Sized on the final build
slides.source: Foot Locker and REI reach from Sabio's March 2026 Zenith competitive audience pull; refresh at build. GameChanger is a DICK'S app, so its users can be reinforced or suppressed. App lists finalized with DICK'S and Zenith.

cards.name: The sneaker household
cards.desc: Foot Locker or Champs app in the home, plus a sneaker drop app. Buys footwear as gifts.
cards.apps: Foot Locker · Champs Sports · Nike SNKRS · GOAT · StockX
cards.goal: Bring the Foot Locker home into DICK'S for the rest of the list

cards.name: The outdoor gifter
cards.desc: Shops REI and plans trips on the phone. Buys jackets, boots and gear in Q4.
cards.goal: Win the outdoor gift before it goes to REI

cards.name: The youth sports parent
cards.desc: Runs a team calendar and scores games on the phone. Buys gear for the next season.
cards.goal: Own the winter sports and spring gear list

channels.head: CTV · 60%

slides.side:
Foot Locker is the newest part of DICK'S, and holiday is its first real season inside the company.

We think the homes that shop both banners are the cheapest growth DICK'S has this quarter.

That said, it only works if we start before the first gifting weekend, so timing matters more than size here.
